## Mathematical disposition

Both original questions in problem **30006465**, rank **1214**, alias **OWR-14299577-018**, are resolved by **Alper Ferudun's 28 September 2026 public note**. This is a mathematical acceptance audit of that existing argument: no correction required, no new solution or independent-discovery claim, and **0 new-proof-search turns**.

For A containing exactly one of k and -k for each 1<=k<=n, at most two positive differences in [1,n] are missing. For every B subset of [1,n], including B empty, the original ordered-pair count is at least floor((|B|-1)^2/4). The audit checks the defect involution, exact half-defect budget, injective charging and both resulting bounds. It also checks the all-n sharpness construction for every n>=2 and 1<=m<=floor(2n/3)+1, the asymptotic constants and the optimal leading coefficient 1/4 for 0<epsilon<=2/3.

The equality cutoff is proved sufficient; its necessity for arbitrary n and the ancillary missing-difference characterization and uniqueness remarks remain unproved. Small-n zero counts are retained, and the original positive-density quadratic assertion is read asymptotically.

## Attribution and source status

Credit goes to Alper Ferudun, [*Differences of Signed Representatives: Sharp Answers to Two Questions of Bernert and Arala Santos*](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23006720), version 1.0, dated 28 September 2026. The original questions are on printed p. 2756 / PDF p. 56 of [OWR 51/2025](https://ems.press/content/serial-article-files/52435), DOI [10.4171/OWR/2025/51](https://doi.org/10.4171/OWR/2025/51).

The prior note explicitly states that it is unrefereed and AI-assisted. This independent audit is also AI-assisted and unrefereed; acceptance does not confer external human peer review or proof-assistant certification. No exhaustive historical-priority certification is asserted.

## Publication boundary

Exactly seven authored-report or public-verification-metadata files are added under `unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/30006465/`. All proof passages, accepted conclusions, boundary checks and prior attribution are retained verbatim. The finite-verification section is removed in full; administrative source-inventory wording is removed or adapted. No omitted computation is converted into replacement prose.

The packet excludes third-party source copies, source extracts, source images, datasets, scripts, standalone computation outputs, logs, private coordination material and identities of nondistributed audit artifacts. Public PDF hashes, byte counts and bibliographic/retrieval/inspection metadata remain. No QUEUE.md, unrelated file, historical status or turn count changes. No merge, release, DOI deposit or external outreach is part of this change.

## Preparation checks

The complete original report and companion documents were read. All original manifest identities and retained public-source identities were verified. Exact editorial differences, preserved proof blocks, UTF-8/JSON, relative links, the seven-file manifest and allowlist, and excluded-material scans were checked. A strict-whitespace clean additive replay reproduced the exact paths and bytes. The fresh complete base Git tree chain and expected ancestor trees were independently rehashed, preserving every unrelated entry including the QUEUE blob. These are packaging checks; no CI pass is claimed. Exact-head remote readback remains a separate publication check.
